about: I am a multidisciplinary digital professional with a love for creative writing, poetry and digital innovation. I help individuals and businesses build their online presence, and I write because some things can only be said in verse.
thoughts: Not every thought needs an audience, but the good ones deserve a page.
Build slowly, say it plainly, and let the work speak.
Some ideas arrive as poems. Others arrive as plans. Write both down.
A blank page is not empty. It is waiting.
